Subject: CAIQ: scoped artifact delivery + upload channel request

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. NovusBank is in the middle of our CSA/CAIQ intake and we'd like to request a small set of artifacts to validate a handful of controls in your CAIQ submission. To keep this efficient and secure we'd prefer to use a pre-signed S3 upload flow (7-day expiry) or an internal secure upload portal.

Scope (high level):
- Controls: CCM-02 (Data Residency), CCS-04 (Key Management), RCV-01 (Runtime Telemetry), APM-03 (Change Control logs)
- Samples requested: recent key rotation record (last 90 days), a 24-hour runtime telemetry extract (redacted for PII), and a change-control ticket export for a model rollout.
- Format: PDFs for policy artifacts; CSV/JSON for logs; a single ZIP for telemetry extracts.

Can you confirm who on your team will own uploads and whether Redwood can provide a presigned URL and short instructions we can follow? Ideally we'd like artifacts staged by Friday, May 23 so our audit intake can proceed.

I've attached the CAIQ scope we use and a short checklist. Let me know if you need a narrower scope.

Cheers,
Audrey Chen
Senior Information Risk Analyst
NovusBank

Hi Audrey — thanks for the clear scope and timeline. We can do a presigned S3 gateway with a 7-day expiry and a small intake playbook. Plan below: 

1) Owner assignment
   - Evidence intake & initial redaction review: Kimberly Park (Security & Compliance)
   - Engineering artifact pull & export (telemetry, ticket export): Priyom Das (Applied ML / Infra)
   - Customer coordination & timelines: me (Jordan Blake)

2) Deliverables we can provide for the requested controls
   - Key rotation record: signed KMS rotation log (PDF + KMS event JSON)
   - Runtime telemetry: 24-hr tokenized trace with PII redacted (JSONL)
   - Change control: ticket export from our deployment system (CSV)

3) Security notes
   - All telemetry will be redacted for PII and tenant identifiers. We will provide a redaction manifest.
   - Presigned URLs will be single-use and expire after 7 days. We will mark uploads with an intake ticket ID.

4) Timeline
   - Presigned URL + upload instructions: today (I can send by EOD)
   - Artifacts staged by: 2025-05-23 (we can expedite if you need earlier)
   - Intake review and initial acceptance: target 2 business days after upload

I've attached our control-tagging template (CSV/XLSX) so you can see how we'll label each artifact against the CAIQ control IDs. Can you confirm the contact who should receive the presigned link on your side?

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Audrey / Jordan — quick technical clarifications from the compliance team before we generate exports: 

- Telemetry: we can provide a JSONL trace with token hashes, request IDs, and latency spans. Will NovusBank accept tokenized IDs rather than raw user IDs? We will include a redaction manifest describing the mapping approach.
- KMS proof: rotation events are stored in our audit ledger; we can provide the signed rotation record and a digest from the KMS. If you need an HSM attestation (TPM/HSM cert), let us know and we'll escalate with infra ops.
- Change control: we can include the ticket export plus the git commit SHAs for the rollout; please confirm if you want full commit diffs or just the rollout metadata.

Also a couple process notes:
- We will run the artifacts through a quick compliance filter before upload (remove any customer PII or tenant-specific secrets). This usually takes < 4 hours for the small sample you requested.
- If NovusBank needs evidence to include log timestamps in UTC, please state that and we'll ensure the JSON includes tz-normalized timestamps.

I'll wait for the contact who will accept the presigned links and the go-ahead on telemetry tokenization.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@novusbank.com>

Thanks Kimberly — that all sounds good. NovusBank can accept tokenized IDs for telemetry (please include the redaction manifest). For change control we only need rollout metadata and commit SHAs (no full diffs). UTC timestamps are preferred.

Contact for uploads: security@novusbank.com (cc'd in the original note). Please send the presigned URL and the short instructions to that address. We will aim to have artifacts uploaded by EOD Friday, May 23. Once uploaded I'll open an intake ticket on our side and confirm receipt.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — happy to jump on a short call if any issues pop up.

Best,
Audrey Chen
